8054.beginText: Fairy Magpie invites you to taste the Osmanthus Wine. Don't forget to bring Ale Granny a bottle!

8058._note: Official step 'Deliver mooncakes to WuKang 33274' dropped: WuKang has no mesh. Slots 2 and 3 are the official chk_quest slots.
8058.beginText: All the mooncakes are ready! Deliver them to Ale Granny and Chang'e, then come back to me.

8059.beginText: We need bamboo to make lanterns. Ask Immortal Zhang for some, then plant the Bamboo.

8061.beginText: Fairy Bell invites you to guess the three lantern riddles.

8063.beginText: Collect flowers and fruit for the lantern festival.

8064.beginText: The Moon Worship is held today. Worship the moon sincerely, then report back to me.

8051._note: [2026-10-15] official Questinfo steps; FlowerBug = festival monster 24187 (DERIVED look), spawned for the player at the osmanthus tree when the quest is taken.
8051.beginText: We are planning to brew osmanthus wine, which requires Osmanthus and distiller`s yeast. Please help us gather them! You can ask Wu Kang for some Osmanthus, and Ale Granny for distiller`s yeast.
8051.finishText: All set! Thank you so much today. We can start brewing the wine now! Come back tomorrow! Here is a reward from Chang`e. Take it!

8052._note: [2026-10-15] official steps; Treant x3 = festival monster 24188 (DERIVED look).
8052.beginText: Brewing osmanthus wine requires glutinous rice, osmanthus, and distiller`s yeast. Please go to Moon Pool and wash rice, then ask Wu Kang for some firewood!
8052.finishText: With firewood, I can start steaming the rice! You`ve worked hard today, so leave the rest to me. Just wait to taste the wine!

8053._note: [2026-10-15] official steps; DrunkGorilla = festival monster 24174 (DERIVED look, official boss 120000 HP).
8053.beginText: You`re just in time! Today I went to check the osmanthus wine and found out it was stolen! Follow the spilled wine on the ground, and you should be able to find the thief!
8053.finishText: It`s a well-known glutton in Moon Palace. Since you taught it a lesson today, it should behave for a while. By the way, the osmanthus wine will be ready tomorrow. Remember to come and taste it!

8056._note: [2026-10-15] official steps; Ham 36978 placed with a DERIVED look (Stove).
8056.beginText: Today we`re making Ham Mooncakes, so we have both sweet and salty flavors! Bell is best at making ham. Please help me ask her for some cured ham!
8056.finishText: Bell is so generous. This ham is top-quality. I`m sure I can make delicious Ham Mooncakes with it! Thank you today. Go get some rest and come back tomorrow to taste the mooncakes!

8057._note: [2026-10-15] official steps; SweetCakeLover / SaltyCakeLover x2 = festival monsters 24175/24176 (DERIVED looks).
8057.beginText: Some of them love sweet mooncakes, and some love salty ones. They`re arguing and even fighting over it! My place is also a mess because of them!
8057.finishText: You did the right thing! These people don`t follow the rules. Thanks to you today, otherwise my mooncakes would have been ruined! Take a rest and come back to help me tomorrow!

8060._note: [2026-10-15] official steps; Moonfish = festival monster 24177 (DERIVED look).
8060.beginText: The frame is done. Next, we need candles. Please go get some Moonfish oil. Moonfish are very rare, so you can only knock them out. Be gentle!
8060.finishText: Great, all the materials for making the lantern are ready. Tomorrow you`ll have your own lantern! Come back tomorrow to get your lantern!

8062.beginText: Look how beautiful the Milky Way is! Lights flicker, stars twinkle! Go float a lantern, and then make a wish. You`ll surely be safe and smooth in the future!
8062.finishText: Drank osmanthus wine, ate mooncakes, and floated lanterns. This Mid-Autumn Festival is truly complete. Now there`s just one last event left. You`ll find out tomorrow!
